I replied to Ilse in your DM: their new cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is 7 July, and it stays between the two of you. I took no other action.

I checked GBrain first. It has nothing about this cutoff date, only older notes on Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets and contacts. I didn't save the date to GBrain. That brain is shared across sources, so saving it there could let others see something Ilse asked to keep private. The DM is the only record of it.
